description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Request class, which encapsulates an XML-RPC request, including method name, parameters, and XML serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request
classes.description: Class representing an XML-RPC request, handling method, parameters, XML parsing, and XML generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new XML-RPC request with optional method and parameters.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the request and updates related XML-RPC value encoding.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the method name to be called; returns false and sets a fault if invalid.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the request, detecting its type if not provided.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters at once, supporting array format with type hints.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the array of parameter types.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML string into the request; sets fault on error.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Checks if the current request has a fault.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Retrieves the fault object if present.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcParams
methods.description: Retrieves parameters as XML-RPC value objects.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Generates the XML request string from the current method and parameters.
